I can't calculate the embedded emissions yet because the scenario doesn't identify the good's CN code. "A steel product" doesn't match any CN code in the factor table, and the ruleset requires a CN code before a default value can be selected.

The quantity (500 t) and country (China) are sufficient. Once you confirm the CN code, the calculation is 500 t × the China default SEE for that code. The China entries in the table are:

| CN code | Good | China default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen, in pigs, blocks or other primary forms | 1.66 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap ingots) | 1.74 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.314 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations, ribs, etc. | 3.169 |

Please provide the CN code for the product, and I'll compute the total, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
